reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A burst-only reading fails because the 72-hour point load exceeds the reported one-hour burst, while an accumulation-only reading misses the record-hour threshold crossing.
reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: The reported one-hour record anchors the urban burst scale, while the point 72-hour load and gridded maxima anchor multiday accumulation scale.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: The nearby point peak should not be used to downgrade the reported city record because the task explicitly separates point and report scales.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON structure with target family, metric groups, final label, and rejected substitutions.
criteria.name: Compact answer structure
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for an incomplete JSON object; 1 point for prose with the right final label.

criteria.description: Computes the report one-hour record minus the previous record, the record ratio, and the threshold-crossed state.
criteria.name: Record-hour threshold
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for citing both depths with one correct derived value.

criteria.description: Computes the point total, peak hour, reported-to-point ratio, rolling 24-hour maximum, rolling 72-hour maximum, and 72-hour fraction.
criteria.name: Point-series rolling load
criteria.partial_credit: 2-3 points for mostly correct point-series values with minor rounding or one missing window.

criteria.description: Reads the three gridded event maxima and computes their maximum spread.
criteria.name: Gridded accumulation spread
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points if at least two gridded maxima and the large accumulation signal are correct.

criteria.description: Computes report-burst to GPM maximum and rolling-72-hour to report-burst ratios, then gives the dual-scale final label.
criteria.name: Scale-partition tests
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for one correct partition ratio and a broadly correct dual-scale conclusion.

criteria.description: Rejects burst-only, accumulation-only, and point-peak-downgrade substitutions without adding uncomputed impact assertions. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.name: Rejected substitutions
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for rejecting at least two of the three substitutions.
